stories.title: Four new gritters join Flintshire fleet a year after Alltami depot fire
stories.summary: Four new gritters are joining Flintshire County Council’s fleet, a year after a fire at its Alltami depot destroyed four gritters. The council said the replacement vehicles come as teams prepare for another winter of round-the-clock maintenance on the county’s roads. stories.title: Unleaded down 6p a litre around Deeside in a month as diesel falls by less than 2p
stories.summary: Unleaded petrol has fallen by an average of 6.1p a litre at forecourts around Deeside in the past month, but diesel has dropped by less than 2p. stories.title: Flintshire meets recycling target but £1m fine still looms
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council still has a Welsh Government fine of more than £1 million hanging over it for missing a statutory recycling target. stories.summary: Work has started on bringing a former industrial site at the Port of Mostyn back into use, as part of a £14.7 million upgrade backed by the North Wales Growth Deal. stories.title: Water back on in villages near Holywell after Welsh Water emergency work
stories.summary: Update:  3.15pm: Water supplies have been restored to homes in the villages south of Holywell, according to Welsh Water. The emergency work had left homes from Pantasaph and Brynford down to Pen-y-parc near Rhosesmor with low pressure or no water since this morning.
